description: Ownership of release and install machinery for the core/plugin split. GateHouse keeps the core release workflow and core install entry; GateProbes owns collector packaging, signing, installation and release. Shared tools have one editable source in GateHouse.

.github/workflows/arc-admin-cost-trial.y.note: Core trial cost workflow; unaffected by the split.

.github/workflows/ci.yml.note: Core CI and its required aggregate; consumes pinned plugin artifacts.

.github/workflows/frontend-advisory.yml.note: Core advisory workflow; unaffected by the split.

.github/workflows/quality-baseline-refre.note: Core quality-baseline refresh; unaffected by the split.

.github/workflows/release.yml.note: Core release chain; keeps the Harness-Gate Sigstore identity.

.github/workflows/rust-generic-shadow.ym.note: Rust reference equivalence shadow; stays in core (5.5).

shared_copy_rule: Gatehouse owns the single editable source. When GateProbes is created it carries generated copies of these files from a pinned GateHouse revision; it never edits its own copy independently.
plugin_release_identity: Declared by GateProbes: its own repository, tag prefix, workflow path and environment rules. A URL substitution must never implicitly change the signed identity GateHouse trusts.
unowned_note: Active release tests are Core/shared-tool governance. Legacy plugin delivery tests and scripts are frozen with exact inventory under retired/legacy-collector.

retired/workflows/native-collector-relea.note: Superseded by the GateProbes native collector chain (rc.8 verified, run 38218575101). Current main no longer triggers it and pull requests and main pushes no longer start it. This does not prohibit creating tags; a tag pointing at a historical commit still runs the workflow as it existed at that commit. Historical releases, signatures and tags are retained. Restore by moving the file back to .github/workflows/ after reverting this record.

retired/workflows/rust-measure-native.ym.note: Built the plugin analyzer from core source on Windows/macOS. Core acceptance now uses the pinned Linux amd64 measurer release; cross-platform analyzer builds belong to GateProbes. Inactive: no pull request or main push triggers it. Restore by moving the file back after reverting this record.

retired/workflows/rust-collector-release.note: Retired from active Core workflows on 2026-10-14; archived bytes are unchanged. Legacy six-asset RSA/Sigstore bundled product remains paused, separate from GateProbes native RC8. Restore only the exact archived bytes from restore_commit, preserving repository/ref restrictions, migration hold, protected environment and approval requirements. Restoring a file does not authorize signing or publication. Any future revival belongs to GateProbes and requires an explicit product decision and reviewed measurement migration; no new credentials, runner or environment are provisioned by this retirement.

frozen_legacy_delivery.note: Paused product; Core executes original negative/lifecycle tests from verified frozen bytes. Any future revival belongs to GateProbes.
